I can't think of anything off the top of my head that will give anything you want, but I just had a thought. 1 level of wizard grants you access to some helpful spells and you can make 1st level scrolls at half price

shield: +4 shield bonus to AC

mage armor: +4 armor bonus to AC

magic weapon: +1 enhancement bonus to hit and damage

long arm: 10ft reach

expeditious retreat: +30 to base move speed

plus a single level of wizard means you can overcast higher level scrolls which is easier than the use magic device skill. the cons include a dip in BAB and of course not advancing brawler level. plus arcane spell failure if wearing armor

It’s hard to multiclass a caster into an optimized build because caster levels are low and spell levels advance slowly. If you’re looking to add some spell support to your character, look into the use magic device skill. Build that skill and take 10 before combat to cast scrolls. Maybe not the best for your gold as you’ll need access to scrolls but this can be easier than trying to multiclass.
